name: Butler Calendar
description: Create and read Google Calendar events through a service account — no OAuth consent screen, no refresh token to expire.

serviceAccountPath.description: Path to a Google service-account JSON key. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/fcm-service-account.json (the same key butler-approvals uses for push). The target calendar must be shared with that account's client_email as 'Make changes to events', and the Calendar API enabled on its project.

calendarId.description: Calendar to write to. Defaults to 'primary'. For a service account, 'primary' is its own calendar — set this to the owner's address (e.g. you@gmail.com) to write to theirs.
